info.title: CERA Main Backend API
info.description: CERA (Container Exception Recovery Agent) Main Backend. Times are ISO 8601 with +09:00; KRW amounts are decimal integer strings.

code.description: Why the address is blocked (a result value, not an HTTP error code)

layer.description: PRODUCT_RULE = Contact Gate, DEV_SAFETY = test recipient allowlist

normalized_address.description: Normalized address. Seed addresses are synthetic *.invalid values

is_simulated.description: MOCK channel — nothing leaves the system

eligible.description: Contact Gate + dev safety verdict at evaluated_at

normalized_address.description: Normalized address. Seed addresses are synthetic *.invalid values

is_simulated.description: MOCK channel — nothing leaves the system

eligible.description: true only when every condition passes and no dev safety reason applies

conditions.description: All six FR-ELG-01 conditions, always in this order

reasons.description: Every blocking reason (not only the first)

dev_safety_applied.description: Whether the test recipient allowlist applied (real channel outside production)

source_path.description: Path inside the source run (requires source_run_id)

target_id.description: TRUCK_SLOT → truck pool of that counterparty (omit = its only active pool) · FACILITY_CAPACITY → warehouse / ODCY (required)

source_run_id.description: Recovery run the values come from (plan-based inquiry)

scenario_id.description: Scenario for a MOCK-channel draft without a source run

status.description: PENDING_APPROVAL = passed the number check; DRAFTED = blocked; CLOSED = superseded

subject.description: null when the content is missing from the content store

related_run_id.description: Recovery context the inquiry came from

ask_id.description: Tag carried in the message so a reply maps back to this question

source_run_id.description: Set when the value came from a recovery run

matched_field.description: Structured value key it matched; null = not in the structured values

unmatched.description: Numbers / dates / times in the text that are not structured values (why it is blocked)

not_mentioned.description: Structured values the text never mentions (information, not a failure)

approved_content_hash.description: msg-content/1 of recipient + subject + body + structured values at approval time

approved_plan_run_id.description: Recovery run the approval was based on (plan-based inquiry)

subject.description: Frozen subject (approval copy); null when the copy is missing

copy_verified.description: The frozen copy re-hashes to approved_content_hash (the approval copy is intact)

state.description: NONE · ACTIVE (live approval) · EXPIRED · REVOKED (operator withdrew) · INVALIDATED (content or plan changed) · REJECTED. Decided by the backend from the approval rows.

usable_for_send.description: The six conditions of a valid approval hold now (docs/22 15.5.1) — the only thing a send may rely on

current.description: Latest APPROVED decision with its frozen copy

ended_by.description: The REVOKED / INVALIDATED row that ended the current approval

history.description: Every decision on this message, oldest first (append-only)

next_message_id.description: Set when this message was replaced by a newer revision

previous_approval_invalidated.description: CONTENT_CHANGED when the previous revision had an approval that this edit invalidated — the new text needs approval again

result.description: null = in progress (no result recorded yet)

error_code.description: Failure reason code (no secrets, no raw content)

reconciled.description: The result was settled by reconciliation (looked up in the channel) rather than by the send call

state.description: NOT_REQUESTED · QUEUED (waiting for the worker) · SENDING (an attempt has no settled result) · RETRY_WAIT (temporary failure, will retry) · SENT · FAILED

can_request_send.description: A send can be requested now (approved, every send check passes, not yet queued)

blocked_reasons.description: Why it cannot be sent now (re-checked on every read, by the worker before every attempt)

next_attempt_at.description: When the next retry may start (RETRY_WAIT)

dequeued_reason.description: Why the worker took it off the queue (policy check failed right before sending — not retried)

sending_paused.description: Sending is paused by the kill switch — requests queue but nothing is sent

field.description: The asked field the AI claims to answer (quantity, available_from, ...)

value.description: Candidate value as the AI normalized it. A suggestion, not a fact

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote the AI gave as evidence (null when the stored quote is gone)

validation.description: Backend validation result. AI confidence is not used

failed_reasons.description: Failed checks: QUOTE_NOT_IN_SOURCE, FIELD_NOT_ASKED, UNIT_MISMATCH:x, VALUE_NOT_IN_QUOTE, CONFLICTING_CANDIDATES, ...

review_status.description: PENDING = passed validation but did not qualify to become a provisional fact (see promotion_blocked_reasons) · ACCEPTED = it became an event (a provisional fact — see fact_event_id) · REJECTED = failed validation

fact_event_id.description: The event this candidate became (T-093). A provisional fact until a human confirms it

promotion_blocked_reasons.description: Why a validated candidate was not turned into a provisional fact (SENDER_NOT_AUTHORITY · WINDOW_OUT_OF_SCOPE · DATE_OUT_OF_SCOPE · DATE_UNVERIFIED · AMBIGUOUS_REPLY · PLAN_SUPERSEDED …). A person decides

generated_by.description: RECORDED_REPLAY = recorded response, no LLM was run

state.description: WAITING (not run yet), DONE (candidates), NO_CANDIDATE, SKIPPED, RETRYING (technical failure, will retry), FAILED (retry limit)

no_candidate_outcome.description: NO_CHANGE, REFUSAL, UNPARSEABLE or VALUES when nothing was extracted

message_id.description: The INBOUND message on the thread — null when held

status.description: NORMAL = attached to its inquiry thread · HOLD = kept (never discarded) but not attached

hold_reasons.description: Why it was held, decided at receipt (registry · thread correlation — no AI)

sender_label.description: Who that address belongs to in the registry, if anyone (display only)

evidence_time.description: Evidence time (docs/22 11.2e): the Date header when valid, else the channel time

thread_counterparty_name.description: Counterparty of the thread it was attached to

content_available.description: The original is still in the content store

extraction.description: AI suggestions for a NORMAL reply, validated by the backend. Null for held mail (never sent to AI)

plan_based.description: true when the values come from a recovery run

number_check.description: Recomputed on every read (deterministic); null when the content is missing

approval_ready.description: Can be approved now — no blocked_reasons (all checks recomputed on read)

replies.description: Replies received on this thread (NORMAL only — held mail is in GET /communication/inbound)

values.description: Optional full set of structured values. A value that differs from the previous one loses its plan source (it is no longer a plan number). Values that define the question (date · window · size type) cannot change — create a new inquiry instead.

approvers.description: Active HUMAN actors who may decide approvals (development stand-in until authentication exists)

content_hash.description: content_hash of the exact content the operator reviewed
content_hash of the content the operator reviewed
content_hash of the approved content the operator asks to send

available.description: Callable now (key configured for LIVE, fixtures present for REPLAY)

from.description: Search start (Asia/Seoul calendar date, arrival basis)

to.description: Search end (inclusive, at most 31 days after from)

truncated.description: Stopped at CERA_PUBLIC_DATA_MAX_PAGES before all rows

at.description: Declared arrival time (port entry declaration) — not a confirmed berthing or discharge

request_kind.description: Declaration stage as the source writes it (e.g. 최초 · 변경 · 최종)

relative_to_received.description: Whether the declared time was before or after the moment CERA received it

mode.description: LIVE = real public API response · REPLAY = synthetic / masked fixture

code.description: Null when the source facility code is non-standard (e.g. starts with *) — the name is kept

call_seq.description: Call sequence as the source writes it (zero padded)

request_params.description: Safe request parameters (never the service key)

role.description: What this event is in the current judgement. WINNER = the current value

valid_from.description: The value applies from here (Asia/Seoul) — the asked date / time window

verified_by_human.description: Entered by a human or confirmed by one

evidence_time.description: Evidence time used for ordering (Q-44 sent time, else received time)

extraction_id.description: The AI extraction this event came from

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the reply (null when none or the stored quote is gone)

generated_by.description: RECORDED_REPLAY = recorded response, no LLM was run

applied_rule.description: Reconciliation rule that picked the current value (R4-a · R4-b · R6 · R10)

current.description: The current value — null when no eligible value exists

held_event_id.description: A weaker, adverse change held for human review (the current value stays)

candidates.description: Every event for this fact, newest first, with its role in the judgement

limitations.description: What this judgement does not cover yet

command_id.description: Retry key — the same command id never creates a second event

value.description: The value the operator reads from the reply (whole number, same unit as the current value)

message.description: Safe human-readable message (no secrets, no raw content)
